summary.text: Larry Springer is a Washington state representative from Kirkland who is Deputy Majority Leader in the House of Representatives. His official biography says he was first elected to the Legislature in 2004.

paragraphs.text: Springer is a lifelong resident of East King County, according to his official biography, and began his career as an elementary school teacher.
The page says he has owned a retail wine store since 1985.
Before the Legislature, the page says, he served 11 years on the Kirkland City Council, including four as Mayor, and he was President of the Suburban Cities Association.
It says he has been a member of the Kirkland Chamber of Commerce and a board member of HopeLink and a founding board member of Leadership Eastside.

The page lists his House committees as Agriculture & Natural Resources, Appropriations, Finance and Rules, and says he earned a BA in Education from Western Washington University and an MS in Family Counseling from the University of Oregon.
